name: Cancellation Process 2 Code
definition: Configuration of the exchanges to perform the cancellation of a payment transaction.

ADVC.name: Advice
ADVC.definition: Card payment transaction may be cancelled by an advice only before closure of the reconciliation period or before the capture by batch.

NALW.name: Not Allowed
NALW.definition: Card payment transaction cannot be cancelled by the acquirer.

REQU.name: Request
REQU.definition: Card payment transaction may also be cancelled after the closure of the reconciliation period or after the capture by batch. In this case a cancellation request exchange is required.

APPL.name: Application Level
APPL.definition: Cancellation of the Card payment transaction is defined by the payment application.
